commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
credential_tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory-db.env.tmp.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$credential_tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
app_password=[REDACTED]]] rand -hex 24)
printf '%s\n' 'DB_HOST=localhost' 'DB_PORT=3306' 'DB_NAME=inventory' 'DB_USER=inventory_app' "DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] > "$credential_tmp"
mariadb --protocol=socket <<SQL
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS inventory CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory.items (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  sku VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uq_items_sku (sku)
) ENGINE=InnoDB;
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'inventory_app'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED]
ALTER USER 'inventory_app'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY [REDACTED]
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON inventory.* TO 'inventory_app'@'localhost';
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
SQL
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$credential_tmp" /etc/inventory-db.env
rm -f "$credential_tmp"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
unset app_password
printf 'inventory configuration applied\n'

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled mariadb
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active mariadb
mariadb-admin --protocol=socket ping
printf '%s\n' 'listener:'
ss -ltnp | grep -E '(:3306[[:space:]])'
printf '%s\n' 'credential_file:'
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a size=%s' /etc/inventory-db.env
awk -F= '{ print $1 "=<redacted>" }' /etc/inventory-db.env
set -a
. /etc/inventory-db.env
set +a
printf 'credential_length=%s\n' "${#DB_PASSWORD}"
printf '%s\n' 'schema_table:'
mariadb --protocol=socket --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ENGINE FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='inventory' AND TABLE_NAME='items';"
printf '%s\n' 'account_scope:'
mariadb --protocol=socket --batch -e "SELECT User, Host, plugin, IF(authentication_string='', 'NO', 'YES') AS credential_set FROM mysql.user WHERE User='inventory_app'; SHOW GRANTS FOR 'inventory_app'@'localhost';"
printf '%s\n' 'application_login:'
MYSQL_PWD="$DB_PASSWORD" mariadb --protocol=socket --user="$DB_USER" --database="$DB_NAME" --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT CURRENT_USER(), DATABASE(), COUNT(*) FROM items;"
unset DB_PASSWORD MYSQL_PWD
